spec.definitions:
def IsLucasSequence (L : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop := ∀ n, L (n + 2) = L (n + 1) + L n

def NecessaryConditions (a : ℕ → ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsLucasSequence a ∧
  (∀ k, (a k).Composite) ∧
  (∀ n > 1, ∃ k, Nat.gcd n (a k) = 1)
spec.proof:
by
  intro a h
  exact ⟨h.2.1 0, h.2.1 1⟩
